320	Forty.	Quarenta.
321	Forty.	Quarenta.
322	What happened?	O que aconteceu?
323	Was he stuck in shidduchim?	Ele estava travado nos shidduchim?
324	Why didn't he marry earlier?	Por que não se casou antes?
325	Others go to the chuppah at 18.	Outros vão à chupá aos 18.
326	What was it, 40 years?	O que foi isso, 40 anos?
327	How did he not find a match?	Como ele não achou um shidduch?
328	Until age 40 he found no match?	Até os 40 anos não achou um shidduch?
329	Today they would call him a "stuck" single.	Hoje o chamariam de solteiro "encalhado".
330	What would they say?	O que diriam?
331	No, that was the question.	Não, essa era a pergunta.
332	But with Yitzchak it's not the same, because Yitzchak Avinu's match had not yet been born.	Mas com Yitzchak não é igual, porque o shidduch de Yitzchak Avinu ainda não tinha nascido.
333	Only at the Akeidah was his match born, and then he was told Rivka was born, and he took her at three.	Só na Akedá nasceu o shidduch dele, e então lhe anunciaram que Rivká nascera, e ele a tomou aos três anos.
334	But today, today that is a relatively late age.	Mas hoje, hoje essa é uma idade relativamente tardia.
335	I didn't understand at all.	Eu não entendi nada.
336	So now, the Kli Yakar writes: why did Avraham Avinu go to Padan Aram to bring	Então agora, o Kli Yakar escreve: por que Avraham Avinu foi a Padan Aram buscar
337	a wife from there?	uma esposa de lá?
338	There are plenty of fish in the sea.	Há muitos peixes no mar.
339	Here in the land of Canaan, were there no women?	Aqui na terra de Canaã faltavam mulheres?
340	There were women.	Havia mulheres.
341	So why did he go there?	Então por que ele foi para lá?
342	He writes: good midot in Padan Aram. That is what the Kli Yakar writes, and I wonder.	Ele escreve: boas midot em Padan Aram. Assim escreve o Kli Yakar, e eu me admiro.
343	A great astonishment.	Uma enorme perplexidade.
344	Good midot?	Boas midot?
345	Yes.	Sim.
346	Good midot in Padan Aram?	Boas midot em Padan Aram?
347	They tried to murder him, to kill him, they switched his cups, they wanted to rob him, they wanted to delay	Tentaram assassiná-lo, matá-lo, trocaram-lhe os copos, quiseram roubá-lo, quiseram atrasar
348	the whole matter: "Let the girl stay with us a year or ten months." After they had said yes,	todo o assunto: "Que a moça fique conosco um ano ou dez meses." Depois de terem dito sim,
349	"Take Rivka and go," they delayed the match, tried to murder him; he tried to murder him and in the end Betuel died,	"Leve Rivká e vá", atrasaram o shidduch, tentaram assassiná-lo; ele tentou assassiná-lo e no fim Betuel morreu,
350	Rivka's father. Lavan tried to rob him: when her brother saw the bracelets	o pai de Rivká. Lavan tentou roubá-lo: quando o irmão dela viu os braceletes
351	that the servant had put on her arm, he immediately ran outside. What made him run?	que o servo pusera no braço dela, saiu logo correndo. O que o fez correr?
352	What were the incentives?	Quais eram os incentivos?
353	Monetary ones, those were the incentives. And furthermore, why Lavan?	Monetários, esses eram os incentivos. E mais, por que Lavan?
354	Lavan the Arami: Chazal expound "Arami" as "rama'i," a swindler. He was a swindler. It was also	Lavan, o Arami: os Sábios expõem "Arami" como "ramai", enganador. Ele era um enganador. Também	
355	not for nothing that they called him Lavan. He was a dealer, he was a user,	não foi à toa que o chamaram Lavan. Ele era um negociante, um aproveitador,
356	he was one of the exploiters. So you come and tell me good midot?	era dos exploradores. Então você vem me dizer boas midot?
357	What good midot?	Que boas midot?
358	Those are good midot?	Isso são boas midot?
359	They tried to murder him, to spoil, to deceive, to steal, to rob, to destroy, to… these are	Tentaram assassiná-lo, estragar, enganar, roubar, saquear, destruir, … isso são
